name: ANZA — Australian & New Zealand Association
summary: Community association for Aussies, Kiwis, and friends — events, sports, and family programming.
body: ANZA is less a facilities club and more a community operating system: sports, socials, and family events that help new arrivals find people quickly. Often one of the highest-ROI belonging moves for ANZ families.
membershipNotes: Annual membership — much lighter than club entrance fees.
